title: What is a good Christmas gift from the dog?
summary: A Christmas gift from the dog can be an illustrated mug, a personality blanket, or a portrait, each painted from the dog's photo. A short note in the dog's voice, signed with its name, comes in the box. Review the artwork before adding it to your cart.

title: What can I get my partner from the dog?
summary: Get your partner something the dog would actually say. A gift "from the dog" works best when it names the dog's real habits: waiting by the door, stealing their side of the bed, the morning walk.

title: How do you sign a gift from the dog?
summary: Sign it the way the dog would: "Love," then the dog's name, with a paw print. "Love, Biscuit" reads warmer than "From Biscuit" and shorter than a full note.
